text:
Type: kids' road map play rug
Use: playing with toy cars on the floor; kids' room, nursery, playroom
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: short printed pile, bound edges
Colors: bright grass green, grey roads, sky blue water, white, red, yellow
Shape: rectangular, flat, printed town roads with a roundabout, helipad, parking spaces, railway tracks and traffic signs, compact
Feel: playful, cheerful, busy, fun
Goes with: white or light wood kids' furniture, primary colors, toy storage; children's bedrooms and playrooms

product.name: STORABO
product.description: Honk and drive! On this rug there are roads, parking spaces, traffic signs and railroads  just like in a city. Perfect to combine with toy cars and figures from the LILLABO series.
